ComposeFile.Name: Pipe Bomb
ComposeFile.Overview: Self-hosted music streaming server. Stream your music library and discover new music through plugins.

Variable.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Variable.Label: Public URL
Variable.Description: The URL you will use to access Pipe Bomb in your browser (e.g. http://192.168.1.100 or http://pipebomb.local). Must match exactly — used for CORS.

Variable.Name: HTTP_PORT
Variable.Label: Port
Variable.Description: Port Pipe Bomb will be accessible on.

Variable.Name: APPDATA_PATH
Variable.Label: App Data Path
Variable.Description: Where Pipe Bomb stores its database, plugins, and cache. Defaults to a ./data folder next to the compose file if left blank.

Variable.Name: MUSIC_PATH
Variable.Label: Music Library Path
Variable.Description: Path to your local music library for the local-library plugin. Also uncomment the MUSIC_PATH volume line in docker-compose.yml to activate it.

Variable.Name: COOKIE_DOMAIN
Variable.Label: Cookie Domain
Variable.Description: Optional. Set to your domain (e.g. mynas.local) if accessing via a hostname so auth cookies scope correctly.
